text:
alex: FYI a customer (acct: brightlane) opened a P1 — p95/p99 spike on /v1/chat/generate after yesterday's rollout, reporting timeouts and degraded throughput.
priya: saw the paging alert earlier, p95 jumped from ~220ms -> ~1.9s, p99 ~6.2s in prod us-west-2.
jamal: stack traces show a lot of worker slowdowns, not full OOMs, but heavy GPU memory churn and periodic stalls.
natalie: they attached traces and a small repro, I pushed to a support ticket: https://support.redwood/BR-1432 (internal link).
alex: can someone run quick live checks: GPU mem usage across the pool, jemalloc stats, kv cache growth per session? suspect KV growth + fragmentation causing stalls.
priya: doing that now, pulling metrics -> `promql: 100*(gpu_mem_used/gpu_mem_total)` for pool redwood-prod-a. Also `sum(rate(kv_cache_size_bytes[5m])) by (worker)`.
priya: immediate numbers: host gpu mem % bouncing 72% -> 98% on a few workers, p95 spikes aligned with KV growth. KV cache bytes per-session trending up over last 6h.
jamal: looking at jemalloc metrics from the pod logs: `allocated: 11.3G active: 14.8G mapped: 23.7G` and `arena.0.resident` shows fragmentation growth. Not releasing back to OS fast.
alex: any recent changes to KV retention logic or chat session behavior? We shipped conversational-preserve-kv flag last week.
natalie: yes we changed the retention policy to keep last 512 tokens of KV by default for chat; that could blow up for multi-turn, multi-user sessions. Support repro shows sessions with 80 turns.
priya: repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/chat/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"session_id":"repro-824","messages":[ ...lots of turns...]'}
```
priya: running that locally with batch=8 reproduces sustained KV growth and p99 stalls after ~120s of continuous conversation.
jamal: quick mitigation options: 1) enable per-session KV cap (30-64) behind feature flag, 2) force periodic KV prune job, 3) backpressure by throttling batch size for affected route, 4) restart impacted workers to reclaim fragmented memory.
alex: do 1 & 4 immediately for the customer and 2 & 3 as followups. Priya, can you flip the kv cap flag and restart the 3 highest-frag hosts? Put a note in the ticket.
priya: flipped `features.kv_cap.default=64` on prod (flag id kv-cap-2026), verifying gate. Initiating rolling restart of workers with frag > 80%.
oncall-alerts: rolling restart scheduled on redwood-prod-a workers: w-17,w-18,w-23 at 16:12 UTC.
priya: restart done for w-17 and w-18, w-23 kept for observation. Initial signal: p95 dropped back to ~300ms on the restarted nodes, p99 improved but still ~2.1s overall (some nodes still hot).
jamal: deployed a short-lived hotfix that triggers jemalloc `mallctl` to purge dirty pages on worker shutdown/startup (hotfix id: allocator-purge-2026). This should reduce mapped size retention.
natalie: also enabled `kv_evict_on_idle=true` to let background job evict long-inactive session keys older than 2h.
alex: customer confirmed better latency on their route after restarts + kv cap flip, they still saw a couple of slow responses but said it's acceptable for now. Put on scheduled follow-up with Eng Runtime.
priya: created a perf dashboard comparing pre/post: https://metrics.redwood/d/kv-frag/BR-1432 (internal). Will monitor over 24h.
jamal: root cause summary (short): misconfigured retention (keep 512 tokens) + heavy multi-turn sessions caused KV cache growth -> allocator fragmentation -> GPU memory churn and stalls at p95/p99. Restarting workers + kv caps + allocator purge reduces p99 regressions.
alex: follow-ups (actions):
- Eng-runtime: implement automatic KV compaction when per-session KV > threshold (owner: jamal, due: 48h)
- Infra: tune jemalloc to return dirty pages faster or switch to the purge-on-threshold behavior (owner: priya, due: 72h)
- Support: notify impacted customers and add mitigations KB (owner: natalie, due: 24h)
- Product: review default retention setting for conversational-preserve-kv (owner: alex, due: next week)
natalie: I'll draft the KB and include repro steps + short-term mitigations (restart, kv cap, feature flag) and linker to dashboards.
priya: logging note — add a per-session `kv_size_bytes` tag to request traces so future triage is faster.
alex: thanks everyone. tagging this resolved for P1 for now, keeping monitoring until tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: Incident BR-1432 marked mitigated by alex at 2026-03-17T16:45:00Z :info:
